issues.claim: Taylor Photo, 6 Corporate Dr, Cranbury (group D, own website taylorphoto.com)
issues.problem: Wrong town/address. The firm's own contact page prints '743 Alexander Road, Princeton, NJ 08540' with the same phone 609-452-9444, and its About page says it was founded in Princeton and its 'current location' is 743 Alexander Road. No Cranbury address appears anywhere on the site. This was NOT flagged by the mapper, so it reads as a confirmed Cranbury prospect.
issues.fix: Delete the entry, or move it to a Princeton-zone list; re-verify whether any Cranbury studio exists before outreach.

issues.claim: Brennan Law Firm, 73 N Main St, Cranbury, website https://www.brennanlaw.org/
issues.problem: The cited website does not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND on two attempts, root and www). Every fact in the entry (address, phone) traces back to that dead domain, so the 'own website with current contact page' evidence cannot be re-confirmed and the site can no longer be used as an activity signal.
issues.fix: Confirm the firm is still trading and get a phone-verified address via Cranbury Township records or a phone call; record the site as dead until a live domain is found.

issues.claim: Cranbury Yoga, 29 N Main St, Cranbury (group B)
issues.problem: The listed address is currently being marketed as vacant retail space: Fennelly Associates' October 2025 flyer for 29 North Main Street describes 4,975 SF 'two open studios' retail/office space available for sale. A yoga studio there in 2026 is therefore very unlikely. The mapper did flag it as 'possibly closed', but it is still carried as a prospect.
issues.fix: Remove from the prospect list (or park as a dead lead) until a working phone/social account confirms operation.

issues.claim: Outlook Eyecare listed in the Cranbury zone
issues.problem: Not a Cranbury business. The practice's own hours-and-location page lists only two offices: 5 Centre Drive #1B, Monroe Township, NJ 08831 and 100 Canal Pointe Blvd Ste 100, Princeton. The Cranbury office the mapper says is 'unconfirmed' does not exist on the site, and the practice is 'an Affiliate of PRISM Vision Group', i.e. a multi-office group rather than a single-site local practice. Also a duplicate risk for whoever covers Monroe.
issues.fix: Move to the Monroe Township zone list (and check the 500-staff/health-system rule for the PRISM affiliate relationship).

issues.claim: Alloy Fitness Network, 10 Abeel Rd, Cranbury, 609-619-8758 (group B)
issues.problem: Inference, not proven: 10 Abeel Road is the address older records give for Refuel Agency, and the listed phone (609-619-8758) is one digit from Refuel's listed 609-619-8763, so this looks like a mis-categorised or stale directory record rather than a fitness business. Unverified either way.
issues.fix: Verify before outreach; drop if it is the Refuel record.

issues.problem: Chas. L. Smith Plumbing & Heating is a Cranbury-based plumbing contractor (its own site: 'plumbing contractor from Cranbury, New Jersey', established 1986, NJ license 7808) and is absent from the list.
issues.fix: Add with website https://www.chaslsmithplumbing.com/ and verify address/phone from the township or a call.

issues.problem: First Choice Electric is a commercial/industrial electrical contractor whose own site gives 2010 Eastpark Blvd, Cranbury, NJ 08512. Not in the list, although the list carries three other electricians.
issues.fix: Add First Choice Electric (phone 732-928-0550 per search snippets; confirm from the site's contact page).

issues.problem: Neovision CPA Consulting is listed by Yellow Pages at 1246 S River Rd, Suite 101, Cranbury (609-531-4444) and runs its own site, but is absent. Its own homepage does not print an address, so the Cranbury branch is directory-evidence only.
issues.fix: Add as directory-evidence entry and confirm the Cranbury suite.

issues.problem: At least one likely Cranbury marketing firm is missing: 20 Lemons, LLC, 23 Cranbury Neck Road, phone 732-207-7114, listed in the Princeton Mercer Regional Chamber member directory. The chamber page returned HTTP 403 to me, so this is search-snippet evidence only.
issues.fix: Verify and add if the Cranbury Neck Road address holds; also check Positive Impact Partners (70 S Main St) and Frank Advertising (339 Princeton-Hightstown Rd).

issues.claim: Stuart E. Alexander, D.M.D. entry has no website
issues.problem: The practice runs its own site (stuartalexanderdental.com) giving 19 North Main Street, Cranbury and (609) 395-8383, which matches the entry, but the entry records no website and 'no practice website found'. Understates the lead quality.

Still unresolved on my pass too: knappscyclery.com did not open for the mapper and I could not confirm the Cranbury store either. A dead lead with 34 N Main St and a phone should not sit in a prospect list unflagged as 'verify'.
issues.fix: Confirm by phone/in person before the zone is worked, or drop.
